decisions.rule: Keep publicly labeled exchange wallet totals, same-wallet net changes, official PoR reserves, customer liabilities, wrapped-token backing and tradable float as separate data concepts.
decisions.rationale: XRP Insights' 22.37B total includes cold custody, omnibus customer wallets and 488.4M non-customer wrapped/insurance/charity balances. Its methodology is direct XRPL account_info plus XRPSCAN labels, but labels are not beneficial-owner proof.
decisions.feature_admission: NO_TRADABLE_FLOAT_FEATURE; retain raw provider-specific snapshots only.

decisions.rule: Record SBI VC Trade's 59.5M XRP across two public-labeled XRPL wallets as exchange/custody infrastructure evidence, not SBI Group treasury or proprietary holdings.
decisions.rationale: The source provides public labels and balances but no official PoR or beneficial-owner breakdown.

decisions.rule: Do not equate the all-exchange -234.9M seven-day same-wallet change with the 233.46M Binance theft. Use Binance-specific -173.2M as the relevant provider observation and keep CryptoQuant's approximately 220M decline as a separate wallet-universe series.
decisions.rationale: The XRP Insights all-exchange total spans 24 venues; Binance-specific movement is smaller. No five-wallet crosswalk, per-wallet history or same-time PoR/customer-liability reconciliation exists.
decisions.feature_admission: EVENT_STUDY_CANDIDATE_ONLY; no exchange-outflow signal until causal classification.

decisions.rule: Keep Japan's 1.38B XRP (6.2% of tracked exchange-wallet total) as exchange registration/HQ grouping, not beneficial-owner residence or corporate treasury.
decisions.rationale: The regional breakdown groups Upbit/Bithumb/Coinone/Korbit, Coinbase/Uphold/Kraken, and Japanese venues including SBI VC Trade, bitbank, Coincheck and bitFlyer.

next_actions: Request/locate official SBI VC Trade PoR or custody disclosures and reconcile its two public wallet labels.
Crosswalk Binance's five incident source wallets against the XRP Insights 153-wallet Binance set.
Obtain raw XRPL transaction histories and validated account balances for all five incident sources and the attacker receiver.
Compare the same-time Binance PoR reserve addresses with customer liabilities when the post-incident snapshot is published.
Keep all exchange-wallet changes out of the price model until cause, universe and customer-vs-reserve classification are stable.
